name: @radar/core-decode
description: Decodes raw Dash Core blocks and transactions (incl. special transactions) to JSON in the browser, via rust-dashcore compiled to wasm

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir dist --out-name core_decode target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/radar_core_decode.wasm && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
